property_summary: For any call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly greater block.timestamp than the previously recorded one, the correct contract always stores pastBlockTime equal to the current block.timestamp (a timestamp), whereas the mutant stores block.number instead and thus will sometimes make pastBlockTime != block.timestamp after such a call.
change_summary: Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, so the stored value differs (different observable state) after calls.
